checks.name: HTTP and file handling
checks.result: 46 API/decoder tests pass, including document inventory without OMR, blank-cover recovery, raster-only previews, isolated invalid page geometry, and common in-memory upload/privacy bounds.

checks.name: Piano and notation editing
checks.result: 122 JavaScript tests pass: the previous 95 plus 9 document-state and 18 asynchronous importer cases. Deferred responses cover cancellation, replacement, stale previews/errors, empty-staff selection, explicit retry, per-page edits and bounded image eviction.

checks.name: Final local checks
checks.result: Local pytest: 59 passed in 8.89 seconds, with one upstream Starlette/httpx deprecation warning. All 122 JavaScript tests pass. Both full CI checks on source commit cbbfa85 pass.

checks.name: PDF decoder integration regression
checks.result: Actual app.decode_score images for all six supplied PDF pages are pixel-identical to the evaluated 2,600-pixel rasters; all 717 MIDI/duration events match the saved evaluation. A regression test fixes the normalized PDF raster dimensions.

checks.name: Launcher
checks.result: The documented Windows .\start.ps1 -NoBrowser -Port 8767 started successfully, returned local health 200, and its task-owned test server was stopped. The main app remains available on 127.0.0.1:8765.

checks.name: Practice defaults and manual choices
checks.result: Actual UI: ordinary 4/4 starts at 72 quarter-note BPM; dense 6/8 starts at 40 dotted-quarter BPM. Manual 65 survives a rhythm edit while the range updates to 48–60; Use suggested applies 56 and resetting notes restores automatic 72. Manual 42 survives PDF page navigation; opening a different score resets its defaults.

checks.name: Scale-aware note names
checks.result: Actual marker and review labels show G-sharp 4 in A major and E-flat 4 in B-flat major; the supplied PDF retains written E-sharp 3. All 15 signatures, naturals, octave boundaries, double accidentals, manual edits, and whole-octave spelling are covered by independent helper tests.

checks.name: Compound export timing
checks.result: A real six-quarter-beat WAV at dotted-quarter 40 lasts 6.16 seconds including release. MIDI encodes 1,000,000 microseconds per quarter, equal to quarter 60. Manual dotted-quarter 45 encodes 888,889 microseconds, equal to quarter 67.5. Browser loop/live tempo/transpose/pause/stop checks pass.

checks.name: Tempo and audition regression checks
checks.result: A stopped seek at beat 7.95 retains its target and 0:07 time at quarter 60 after tempo/transposition changes. Changing transpose during a first-load audition cancels the old pitch and stale highlight. Paused transposition preserves Resume. Desktop/mobile scrollWidth equals clientWidth: 1425/375 pixels respectively.

checks.name: Automatic PDF recognition
checks.result: An original six-page fixture has blank first and last pages. All six are scanned: four ready and two with no staff. The first playable page (2) is selected automatically; blank-page playback is disabled while navigation remains available.

checks.name: Preserved corrections and originals
checks.result: On page 3, MIDI pitch 67, duration 1.5, staff-1 tempo 65, staff-2 selection and tempo 42 survive navigation and preview eviction. Original detection still restores MIDI pitch 61 and duration 1. Pasting a replacement image inside the editor closes obsolete controls without JavaScript errors.

checks.name: Real six-page PDF Stop/Resume
checks.result: The actual supplied PDF paused at 2 of 6 completed pages; the late in-flight response did not advance the stopped scan. Resume started at page 3 and finished all six ready. Per-page staff counts were 6, 6, 7, 6, 6 and 5, totaling 36. Page 1 stayed selected and playable, with automatic tempo 72 and no JavaScript errors.

checks.name: Memory and failure boundaries
checks.result: The cache retains at most three PNG previews while keeping recognition and corrections. Evicted images use /api/preview without OMR. Metadata discovery is independent of recognition and page geometry; a malformed page fails locally. Large inventories use bounded nearby-page options plus a page-number jump.

private_score_summary: The complete six-page supplied PDF was processed locally at a 2,600-pixel long edge: 36 staves and 717 note events in 16.6 seconds total. The independent reviewer visually checked 13 complete staves / 258 events across all six pages, including all 97 notes and rhythms on the last page. All identified flag, sharp, false-rest and key errors were repaired. This does not mean all 717 events were manually verified or guarantee accuracy for arbitrary scores.
audio_summary: The embedded synthetic edited baseline phrase was rendered at 90 quarter-note BPM: stereo 44.1 kHz, 16-bit PCM, 5.8267 seconds, RMS 0.00946 and a strongest FFT bin near 293 Hz (D4). For the new tempo behavior, a six-quarter-beat compound phrase at dotted-quarter 40 rendered 6.16 seconds with matching MIDI quarter 60; dotted-quarter 45 exported MIDI quarter 67.5. Physical speaker output was not instrumented.
browser_summary: Final browser checks cover automatic all-page import, blank covers, page-level errors, first playable selection, Stop/Resume, edit/original/staff/tempo retention after preview eviction, safe editor replacement, and desktop/mobile navigation. The supplied PDF is left loaded with all six pages ready. Earlier practice tempo, note spelling, playback and export checks remain valid. English is the only implemented language.
limitations: Recognition is an editable heuristic draft for clean, level, printed monophonic treble/bass staves. High reading confidence does not guarantee transcription accuracy.

Handwriting, perspective photos, dense/chordal notation, multiple voices, ties, tuplets, repeats, grace notes and expressive performance are not reliably interpreted. Phrase slurs are ignored; ties require manual consolidation.
Staves play independently; the app does not infer multi-staff instrument parts or join systems. A key signature alone does not determine major versus minor mode.

Uploads are bounded to 25 MiB and raster images to 30 megapixels; processed images have a 2,600-pixel long-edge limit. Local process/browser memory and operating-system swap remain outside application storage controls.
Audio needs a browser gesture and can be suspended by background/locked-device policies. WAV is limited to ten minutes; transport is limited to thirty minutes and 20,000 events.
The server is intended for loopback use. It has no public-hosting authentication or deployment hardening. Initial dependency installation needs internet access.

review.evidence: Metadata-only inventory discovers every page independently of OMR. Blank/no-staff covers and invalid per-page geometry no longer block later music. All three routes share bounded in-memory upload/privacy rules; 46 decoder/API tests pass. The actual six-page PDF completed automatic recognition after Stop/Resume.

Recognition semantics retain prior independently reviewed evidence. Actual all-page browser processing reports six ready pages with staff counts 6, 6, 7, 6, 6, 5, totaling 36. A synthetic six-page PDF with blank first/last pages reports four ready and two no-staff pages, automatically selecting page 2 without hiding failures.

The document model preserves result identity, original detections, edits and staff selection while evicting only image bytes. Browser evidence verifies pitch 67, duration 1.5 and per-staff tempos 65/42 surviving multi-page navigation and preview eviction; reset restores original pitch 61/duration 1. Prior notation/naming tests remain in the full 122-test JavaScript suite.

Page changes stop the inactive performance and bind playback/exports to the selected stored staff. Background queue completion does not replace an explicitly selected page. The real PDF remained playable on page 1 while scanning was paused and after all six pages completed. Existing audio scheduling, conversion and export checks remain unchanged and passing.

Automatic all-page scanning, per-page statuses, Stop/Resume, explicit retry, retained corrections/manual tempos and raster-only cache recovery are integrated. Real PDF scanning paused at 2 of 6 after its in-flight response settled, resumed at page 3 and finished 6 of 6 ready while retaining page 1. New import/paste closes obsolete editor controls safely.

Reviewer independently inspected updated real-server desktop/mobile and blank-cover screenshots. Page selection, progress, retry and disabled blank-page playback are coherent and readable. Large inventories use bounded nearby-page options plus page jump rather than eager option allocation. English remains the only language; no formal assistive-technology certification is claimed.

Reviewer independently ran 27 model/controller tests, all passing, and inspected deferred race expectations. Full local results are 59 Python and 122 JavaScript passes. GitHub CLI independently confirms both CI checks on source commit cbbfa85 succeeded. Generations protect inspect/analyze/preview/error responses; a three-preview LRU retains edits and raster misses never rerun OMR.

Focused importer/document modules and PDF API/state documentation explain ownership, cancellation and memory boundaries. Public screenshots use original synthetic notation, including the failed cover; tracked source inspection excludes private PDFs, extracted page/event data, environments and caches. PR 3 is ready, mergeable and clean at cbbfa85; final report and immutable documentation-head audit are tracked separately before merge.
